steps.presenter_line: Nhóm xác nhận backend, model và frontend đã sẵn sàng trước khi bắt đầu phần demo.
steps.operator_action: Run python scripts/run_all.py; verify API and Streamlit health; open Home; keep canonical input ready.
steps.input: Canonical fixture path and known ports 8000/8501
steps.expected_visible_state: API health is healthy with model_loaded=true; frontend health is HTTP 200; Home opens.
steps.failure_action: Check health once, retry once if quick, then use OFFLINE_PRECOMPUTED with disclosure.
steps.skip_rule: Must run before the timed demo; do not skip readiness classification.
steps.evidence_source: Feature 3.6 demo runbook; scripts/run_all.py; 2026-08-11 technical dry-run

steps.presenter_line: Nhóm sẽ demo prediction, explanation và What-if, sau đó xem nhanh dashboard; đây là model estimate chứ không phải cam kết thực tế.
steps.operator_action: Show app title, backend status and prototype warning; navigate to Predict.
steps.expected_visible_state: HitRadar Pro overview and limitations warning are visible.
steps.failure_action: If UI is fatal, move to disclosed offline evidence; do not claim missing media is available.
steps.skip_rule: May shorten to 15 seconds, not omit the estimate/prototype framing.

steps.presenter_line: Input gồm 18 trường đã kiểm chứng; output là điểm popularity ước lượng, không phải xác suất hay bảo đảm.
steps.operator_action: Load the 18 canonical values and click Predict Popularity.
steps.expected_visible_state: SUCCESS; prediction display about 46; model EXP24-XGB-FINAL-001 v1.0.0.
steps.failure_action: Correct validation once; otherwise one health check and one quick retry, then disclosed precomputed Predict.
steps.skip_rule: Anchor step; never skip. Offline replacement must be explicitly labeled precomputed.

steps.presenter_line: Đây là các đóng góp của feature vào dự đoán của model; SHAP mô tả model behavior, không chứng minh quan hệ nhân quả.
steps.operator_action: Open Explain only after live Predict; highlight at most 2-3 largest visible contributions without pre-naming them.
steps.expected_visible_state: Prediction matches Predict and contribution visualization is visible.
steps.failure_action: Do not wait; state that Explain did not respond in time and skip without fabricated SHAP values.
steps.skip_rule: Skip on slow response, API failure or any offline mode; offline status is NOT_AVAILABLE.
steps.evidence_source: feature_3_8_final_live_demo_smoke.json; frontend Explain page; historical 2026-08-11 timeout retained only for recovery planning

steps.presenter_line: Ta thay đổi một input và xem hai model predictions khác nhau ra sao; delta không phải tác động thực tế.
steps.operator_action: Select energy; change 0.793 to 0.95; click Compare Predictions; read before/after/delta from UI.
steps.expected_visible_state: SUCCESS; before equals Predict; after and delta are visible. No direction is assumed in advance.
steps.failure_action: Retry once only if quick; otherwise skip and do not invent a delta.
steps.skip_rule: Skip when Predict baseline is absent, API fails, or mode is offline.

steps.presenter_line: Trang mô tả đúng local dataset đang đọc; các chart không đại diện toàn bộ âm nhạc và không hàm ý nhân quả.
steps.operator_action: Show Dataset coverage caption and Songs per Year only; read current values from UI.
steps.expected_visible_state: Dataset coverage caption and Songs per Year chart render; current parse is 586672 rows over 1900-2021.
steps.failure_action: If local data fails, state that the dashboard data did not load and move on.
steps.skip_rule: If time is short, show caption only; never substitute the project-story dataset count for current UI coverage.
steps.evidence_source: frontend pages/4_Trends.py; current local dataset technical parse

steps.presenter_line: Model là XGBoost EXP24-XGB-FINAL-001 v1.0.0; đây là research prototype và các công cụ chỉ mô tả model behavior.
steps.operator_action: Show Model ID, Family and Version; open Limitations; do not read absent metrics.
steps.expected_visible_state: Identity/version and responsible-use limitations are visible.
steps.backend_endpoint: GET /model-info for identity; NONE for Limitations
steps.failure_action: Use validated static identity snapshot and explicitly call it a snapshot; continue to local Limitations.
steps.skip_rule: May shorten, but retain prototype, estimate and noncausal limitations.
steps.evidence_source: current /model-info dry-run; frontend Model Info and Limitations pages

steps.presenter_line: Nhóm chỉ khẳng định điều đang hiển thị và tách model behavior khỏi tác động thực tế. Cảm ơn hội đồng.
steps.expected_visible_state: Limitations remains visible and demo ends cleanly.
steps.skip_rule: Do not omit the responsible-use closing line.
steps.evidence_source: Feature 3.8 project story and claim policy
